comment: Pinned external Restate server release. Deliberately not an npm dependency;
The binary is acquired by an explicit operator command, never by a lifecycle
hook, and this file is the content authority: the digest below is what the
archive must hash to, and binarySha256 is what the extracted binary must
hash to. Pinning only the archive would leave the binary self-attested: a
substituted binary with a matching receipt would pass.
A platform absent from this file is refused. There is no trust-on-first-use.
